title: Life-Draining Origin
text: Process one Dark Microcore through advanced condensation to obtain a Life-Draining Origin.

Place a Life-Draining Origin in an element slot. Triggers a 1.5-block-radius cloud for 20 seconds, dealing 1 base damage per second and healing the caster for actual damage dealt. The cloud can also harm the caster; this self-damage grants no healing.
Each Delay adds 20 seconds; each Enhancement adds 1 base damage per second. Infusion seeks entities within 5 blocks, including the caster. Only area bonuses enlarge the cloud.
